Project$new()

Create a `Project` object.

Usage

Project$new(
  zones,
  dataset,
  tiles,
  features,
  locks,
  costs,
  solutions = list(),
  name = "Project",
  author_name = "Unknown",
  author_email = "Unknown",
  version = "Unknown"
)

Arguments

zones

`character` vector of zone names.

dataset

[new_dataset()] object.

tiles

`list` of [new_tile()] objects.

features

`list` of [new_feature()] objects.

locks

`list` of [new_lock()] objects.

costs

`list` of [new_cost()] objects.

solutions

`list` of [new_solution()] objects. Defaults to an empty list.

name

`character` name of the project. Defaults to `"Project"`.

author_name

`character` name of the project author. Defaults to `"Unknown"`.

author_email

`character` email of the project author. Defaults to `"Unknown"`.

version

`character` value with package version used to create the project. Defaults to `"Unknown"`.

Returns

A new `Project` object.

Project$get_centroid()

Get centroid.

Usage

Project$get_centroid()

Returns

A `numeric` vector with two values.

Project$get_bbox()

Get the bounding box.

Usage

Project$get_bbox(native = TRUE, expand = 0)

Arguments

native

`logical` value indicating if the bounding box should be in (`TRUE`) the native coordinate reference system or (`FALSE`) re-projected to longitude/latitude?

expand

`numeric` value denoting the proportion to expand the bounding box. For example, `expand = 0.1` would expand the bounding box by 10 percent. Defaults to 0.

Returns

A [sf::st_bbox()] object.
